why: Lint cycle 3 (docs/v3/cycles/lint-3.md, lint-3.13 to lint-3.15 P2, lint-3.18 P3). Three guards around the rules disagree with what the rules tell an agent. `basalt-ui eject` answers 'See basalt-ui eject --help', and `--help` prints the top-level usage, which lists no eject: `src/cli/index.ts:1128` short-circuits `--help` on any subcommand, so `EJECT_HELP` is unreachable, while every primitive `Next:` rung sends the agent to eject. Doctor's file-level-disable message names `ignorePatterns` for a generated file and passes it, and the editor hook's pre-edit denies that very write with 'waive the line with a reasoned directive', which a regenerated client cannot carry. check-theme, kept on the v3 surface by v3-lint-2-wiring, still reads `'Closes #1042'` and `'PR #421'` as raw hex and prints 'Route color through VX.* / the Mantine theme'; the playground's two `theme-allow` lines exist only for it. P3: pre-edit lets a nested `.oxlintrc.json` with no basalt extends through (doctor reports it, W6), and the budget breach reads '1 waivers'. Probes: `docs/v3/cycles/lint-3/fixtures/hook.sh` and the commands in lint-3.md.
what: The eject help is reachable, doctor and pre-edit agree on a generated file, and check-theme stops reading an Issue number in prose as a colour and names no Mantine.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/index.ts and src/cli/help.ts (the --help short-circuit and the usage line)
packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/eject/help.ts (only if the doc generator needs it)
packages/basalt-ui/src/cli/check-theme*, packages/basalt-ui/src/guard/** (raw-hex and the fix text)
apps/playground/src/recipes/file-drop.tsx and timeline.tsx (their theme-allow lines only, if check-theme leaves the surface)
change: `basalt-ui <cmd> --help` prints the command's own help where one exists (eject's `EJECT_HELP` at least), and the top-level usage lists `eject` (lint-3.13). One rule for a generated file under a declared root, shared by doctor's weakened-config check and pre-edit: a path the manifest or a `*.gen.*` name marks as generated may go into `ignorePatterns`, and pre-edit's denial names that route instead of a line waiver (lint-3.14). check-theme's raw-hex skips `#` plus digits after a word in prose, and its fix text names `VX.*` and the series file with no Mantine; or, if nothing v3 needs the verb, it leaves the v3 surface with the playground's two theme-allow lines and a MIGRATING row (lint-3.15). P3: pre-edit denies a nested `.oxlintrc.json` whose extends lacks `.oxlintrc.basalt.json`, and the breach message agrees in number (lint-3.18).
commits: fix: one commit per guard in packages/basalt-ui; a playground commit of its own if the theme-allow lines go.
proof: `basalt-ui eject --help` prints the eject usage; hook.sh from lint cycle 3 denies H5; a generated client's ignorePatterns entry passes doctor and pre-edit; check-theme on `{ title: 'Closes #1042' }` reports nothing.
acceptance: pre-edit allows the generated-file ignorePatterns entry doctor accepts, and denies one over a hand-written subdirectory (test)
check-theme reports nothing on an Issue number in prose and its output names no Mantine, or the verb no longer ships (test)
out_of_scope: Rule forms and messages (v3-lint-3-lint); the eject zone (v3-lint-3-eject-static).
